name: Medi Assist Healthcare Services Ltd
title: Medi Assist Healthcare Services Ltd - 544088 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Medi Assist is a TPA/tech platform with no capacity cycle; FY26 operating EBITDA margin 19.3% rising quarterly (Q4 19.9%), debt-free, but retail TPA premium grew only 4.2% and group retention slipped to 93.2%.

triggers.label: Group yields compressing; mgmt says internal metrics healthy
triggers.quote: On the whole, it might look like the yields are compressing, but our internal metrics, we track more on the effort versus the life

triggers.label: Group retention 93.2%, below 94%+ history
triggers.quote: on group side, yes, it is marginally lower than our historical 94%+

triggers.label: Retail TPA premium growth 4.2%
triggers.quote: The retail premiums in the TPA model were INR2,818 crores, a growth of 4.2% year-on-year.

triggers.label: Q4 EBITDA margin 19.9% vs 18.6% Q3
triggers.quote: The quarter four EBITDA profile was 19.9 percentage versus 18.6 percentage in Q3 and 17.1 percentage in Q2.

triggers.label: Paramount integration within 1-2 quarters
triggers.quote: I think we still track to being 1 or 2 quarters at the most from a Paramount perspective.

guidance.value: at least 1.5 to 2x traditional TPA margin (directional, not guidance)
guidance.quote: hopefully be able to charge in some cases on outcomes and with a higher margin profile of maybe at least one and a half to two times the traditional you know TPA business
from an overall industry growth perspective, we will match or better.
I think we still track to being 1 or 2 quarters at the most from a Paramount perspective.

red_flags.label: Unresolved exceptional items / disallowed claims
red_flags.quote: those exceptional items that we've provided, they still continue to be open items including our insurance claims to the claims disallowed item

red_flags.label: Group yield compression
red_flags.quote: On the whole, it might look like the yields are compressing

evasions.topic: Take rate / yield trajectory over 5 years
evasions.quote: I think it's very hard for me to forecast what will happen 5 years later.
I think we've typically not disclosed some of these revenue metrics as in the past

evasions.topic: Bima Sugam impact on near-term business
evasions.quote: I know it's a long-winded answer, but it will be unfair for me to limit this only to Bima Sugam.
